name: figlens MCP
description: Reads saved Figma .fig files offline: tree, find, inspect, nodes and variables return design data; bundle and export write a zip or an image to a caller-named path. gs:// inputs are fetched through the local gcloud CLI. Off until enabled locally.
saferAlternatives: Start the server as `figlens mcp --root <designs-folder>`: every file and output path a call names must then resolve inside that folder, and calls whose arguments leave the tool schema are refused.
Use inspect or nodes for layout, text and style values; bundle and export are only needed when files must be written.
Keep design files local; a gs:// path runs the gcloud CLI to download the object before it is read.
